note: The Claude models agy serves on the Google AI Pro subscription (agy 1.2.17 `agy models` lists Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5, each at Low, Medium and High). A merge patch over agy-tmux (`base`): the same agy binary, driver, prompts, controls and environment; its own tier map, model family and default tier. agy offers no Haiku-class Claude, so fast is Sonnet at Low effort. `params.model_tier.default` keeps a model-less launch (a probe or a canary) on a Claude model, never agy's Gemini default. `update_argv: null` opts this target out of the shared agy binary's updater, which only agy-tmux owns, so a boundary update runs agy once. See docs/architecture/packages/internal-bridge.md.
